description: This file defines the DataCell class, a GUI component representing a cell in a data table for a tuning/logging application. It manages rendering, user interaction, and data representation for individual data points in the application.

classes.name: DataCell
classes.description: A GUI label component representing a cell in a data table with functionality for rendering, interaction, and data management within the tuning application.

methods.name: DataCell
methods.description: Constructor initializing a DataCell with reference to the parent table.

methods.name: DataCell
methods.description: Constructor initializing a static data cell with specific text.

methods.name: DataCell
methods.description: Constructor initializing a DataCell with original value and position.

methods.name: getBinValue
methods.description: Returns the raw (bin) value this cell represents.

methods.name: getRealValue
methods.description: Returns the evaluated real-world value based on current scale expression.

methods.name: setRealValue
methods.description: Sets the cell's value by parsing and evaluating a string expression.

methods.name: getCompareValue
methods.description: Returns the difference between the current bin value and compare-to value.

methods.name: getRealCompareValue
methods.description: Returns the difference of real-world values based on the current scale.

methods.name: getRealCompareChangeValue
methods.description: Calculates the proportional change between current and compare values.

methods.name: getCompareColor
methods.description: Determines the color representing comparison difference.

methods.name: getBinColor
methods.description: Determines the background color based on bin value and limits.

methods.name: drawCell
methods.description: Refreshes the visual representation of the cell.

methods.name: getCellBackgroundColor
methods.description: Retrieves the background color considering highlight, selection, and bin color.

methods.name: getCellTextColor
methods.description: Retrieves the text color based on tracing and highlight status.

methods.name: getCellBorder
methods.description: Determines the border style based on tracing and value change.

methods.name: getCellText
methods.description: Generates the display text for the cell based on current value and display mode.

methods.name: getCellToolTip
methods.description: Provides tooltip text for the cell.

methods.name: getLiveValue
methods.description: Returns the current live data trace value.

methods.name: getLiveValueString
methods.description: Formats the display string including live trace info.

methods.name: setBinValue
methods.description: Updates the bin value with range checking and updates visual state.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation (display value) of the cell.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks whether the cell is selected.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the selected state and updates visual rendering.

methods.name: setHighlighted
methods.description: Sets the highlighted state and updates visual rendering.

methods.name: isHighlighted
methods.description: Checks whether the cell is highlighted.

methods.name: mouseEntered
methods.description: Handles mouse entering the cell area for highlighting.

methods.name: mousePressed
methods.description: Handles mouse press for selection or interaction.

methods.name: mouseReleased
methods.description: Handles mouse release event.

methods.name: mouseClicked
methods.description: Event handler (empty) for mouse click.

methods.name: mouseExited
methods.description: Event handler (empty) for mouse exit.

methods.name: clearCell
methods.description: Clears highlight and selection states.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the cell's value by a specified amount.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Reverts cell value to original.

methods.name: setRevertPoint
methods.description: Sets current value as revert point.

methods.name: setOriginalValue
methods.description: Sets the original value for undo operations.

methods.name: setCompareValue
methods.description: Sets the compare-to value from another cell.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies the cell's bin value by a factor.

methods.name: setLiveDataTrace
methods.description: Enables or disables live data tracing.

methods.name: setLiveDataTraceValue
methods.description: Sets the live trace value string.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves current application settings.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another DataCell object.

methods.name: getStaticText
methods.description: Returns formatted static text if static data mode.

methods.name: setY
methods.description: Sets the y coordinate position.
